finding: Three shared-weight ABBA rounds (six complete trajectories per mode) measure median ordinary 16.924766s versus cached 16.031136s including fresh, used positive/negative prefill each trial (5.28% lower). All native states in every trial equal the sealed original ordinary control bitwise, with no measured Dynamo/XLA compilation or fallback. Native main products remain457 ordinary/425 cached plus32 prefill. Original12steps/21calls and stock CPU gates are unchanged; inherited29.99% final error still fails them.
tests: 8 focused CPU checks pass, including inline original-LoRA/value identity. Full pretrained CPU cached trajectory is bitwise ordinary; sealed native source/input/config identity is verified. Every original sampler state in every complete timed trial is bitwise the accepted ordinary native trajectory. Every window has unchanged Dynamo and XLA compile counts; no fallback.
limits: Same synthetic512 fixture, single n150 Wormhole chip and one process; temporal drift is counterbalanced within ABBA rounds but this is not multi-device/multi-scene statistical evidence. All learned parameters are original quantized values promoted to FP32. No geometry/material or default1024 cascade validation. Graph/operator counts are not device-kernel timing attribution.
decision: Retain conditioning reuse as a measured opt-in execution improvement, numerically neutral against the ordinary TT recipe. Pursue strict accuracy gates and real-scene/memory validation before default promotion.
